bias_targets.methodology: Automatic detection and filtering using a classifier trained on a Korean hate speech dataset to score and discard sentences with a predictive score of 0.5 or higher from the source corpora.

bias_targets.target: General Social biases (Race, Nationality, Religion, Age, Disability, Socioeconomic Status, etc.)
bias_targets.methodology: Manual inspection and filtering by crowdworkers and expert inspectors who were provided explicit ethical guidelines to flag and exclude examples containing overgeneralized prejudices during the dataset annotation process.
